### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **18** documentable anchor(s).

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1ea4f846117b9c3e61c4dd2a54fca7cf1b4ce5f1` — the merge of head `35bdb5bacfcdd68e0ddd025cb4a1db683a1e4524` into base `62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1ea4f846117b9c3e61c4dd2a54fca7cf1b4ce5f1 && git checkout 1ea4f846117b9c3e61c4dd2a54fca7cf1b4ce5f1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f 35bdb5bacfcdd68e0ddd025cb4a1db683a1e4524 && git checkout -B drift-repro 62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f && git merge --no-ff 35bdb5bacfcdd68e0ddd025cb4a1db683a1e4524

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 62692b7f8b39597db2549f8821547e99e3294e3f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head 35bdb5ba · 2026-11-24T10:53Z

L1 read of #36933 (card #36834, p2, the maintainer's direct order with rulings at 03:12Z and 03:16Z) at `35bdb5bacfcdd68e0ddd025cb4a1db683a1e4524`. Clause-② no and Metadata-protocol none, both true: the change is navigation and console only, and no spec file is touched. NOT governed (0 of 38 paths hit the register). 1,159 changed lines on the card's one PR, under the per-card line, so it takes an ordinary queue landing.

**Against the card, item by item.**
1. **Setup entry.** `nav_packages` goes in `group_apps`, unfiltered, with `params: { face: 'admin' }`. It is gated on `manage_platform_settings`, the same gate as `nav_settings_hub` and Public Forms, which satisfies item 4. The server's `manage_metadata` write gates are untouched. The label is in all 11 Setup locales. `setup-packages-door.test.ts` is restated, not loosened: exactly one package-list entry, the gate, and Studio's own development entry still shipped.
2. **One page, two faces.** The face is chosen by `readPackagesFace`, the selector the PR names, and no new page, widget, hook or route is added. `PackageDetailSheet` gates every authoring control on `authoring = face !== 'admin'`: Edit, Publish, Revert, Export, Duplicate, Adopt, the drafts block and browse-metadata. Disable / Enable and Delete keep their own conditions, and the keep-data dialog is unchanged. `onCreated(id)` is wired from `CreatePackageDialog`'s `r.id`. On the admin face it forgets the list reads and navigates to `/studio/ID/data`, BuilderLanding's `open` address. The ablation (`authoring = true`) reds the admin-sheet test.
3. **Studio is unchanged.** The face defaults to `development`, the development header still carries Import, New Package and the platform switch, and the CONTROL cases pin it.
5. The comments that cited ruling 甲 are rewritten in `setup-nav.contributions.ts`, `BuilderLanding.tsx` and `marketplace-ui.ts`.
6. **Installed Apps retires.** `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` keeps its id and its export, with `navigationContributions: []` and the version bumped to 0.4.0. The pin is restated as an absence pin with a positive control (Browse lands in the same group). The id joins the dead-key tombstone. A legacy `?source=marketplace` URL with no `face` reads as the admin face, and `setSourceFilter` writes `face=admin` with every pick, so pressing "All" from that address stays on the admin face. The seat owns the cloud half (mailbox #36743 7128073202).
7. **Source filter.** A `ToggleGroup` offers All plus the closed set `PACKAGE_SOURCES`, writing `?source=`. A press on the chosen value (`''`) is ignored rather than read as "no choice". An unknown or repeated `face` is refused by name, like `source`.
8. **Built from `installedAppsView`.** The admin face is grouped over every source. Kernel packages are hidden, and only marketplace rows are asked about updates or draw the Update cell.

**Fix round (35bdb5ba).** The cli pin moves 35 → 37 because `group_apps` is served again in the marketplace-less composition. The count stays exact, and `group_apps`'s children are asserted by name. It is outside the claim's surface, but the fix-round order directed it. The locale and source-hash breach is mechanical, and the seat accepted it.

**Changeset.** It names platform-objects, cloud-connection, app-shell and i18n, all at patch, as the card asks, and each sentence holds against the diff. The one `l1-face` flag, `@objectstack/cli`, is a test under `packages/cli/test/`: `files: ["dist", …]` ships no test, so no entry is owed.

**Acceptance.** The zh screenshots the card names are in project files under `issue-36834/` and listed in the body. I opened the list and the authored detail: the list shows 软件包 with the 来源 filter, a single 新建软件包 and no 导入. The detail shows 查看信息 / 禁用 / 删除软件包 plus 在 Studio 中打开. The live account covers disable/enable, both delete modes, create → Studio, the old link and Studio unchanged. Delete's feedback (the sheet closes and the row leaves the list) is the existing behaviour on both faces. It is a declared deviation, accepted.

**Nits (none block).**
- N1. The zh admin description says 「启用、停用或删除」, but the button, status and every other packages string say 禁用 / 已禁用. The new sentence should say 禁用 to match. The en string is fine.
- N2. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` (about lines 2393, 2404 and 2441) still describes the retired Installed Apps entry. It is outside this card's surface, and the dev noted it but did not file it, so the seat files the card.
- N3. Draft #34223 restates the same cli count. Whichever lands second re-counts, so the seat sequences them.

**Mechanical.** All-checks: 60 success · 12 expected skips · 0 failed · 0 pending. Floor checks are green, `mergeable_state` is clean, and the face is `Fixes #36834`, which delivers items 1–8.

Every open finding is a nit. **ACCEPT**, ordinary queue landing.
